description: We are STEM students from Egypt with a passion for science, technology, and space. We believe that innovation begins with curiosity, collaboration, and the willingness to explore new ideas. Our different skills, perspectives, and experiences enable us to creatively tackle challenges, learn from one another, and create solutions that can make a difference. By taking part in the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we can apply our curiosity and push ourselves to create solutions to real-world problems.
